ui.notices.agents.config_run_changed.role: success toast body after a configuration run that created definitions
ui.notices.agents.config_run_changed.note: Names the outcome as changed because at least one definition was newly created. Count is the number of definitions the run touched.

ui.notices.agents.config_run_updated.role: success toast body after a configuration run that only updated definitions
ui.notices.agents.config_run_updated.note: Used when no definition was created, only updated. Same count as config_run_changed.

ui.notices.agents.created.note: A new agent definition was written. No name is shown in this arm.

ui.notices.agents.created_named.role: success toast body with the created agent's name
ui.notices.agents.created_named.note: A new agent definition was written; the name is user data and must not be translated.

ui.notices.agents.exported.note: An agent definition was exported to a file.

ui.notices.agents.imported.note: An agent definition was imported from a file.

ui.notices.agents.installed.role: success toast body with the installed agent's name
ui.notices.agents.installed.tone: Confirmation plus what the reader can now do.
ui.notices.agents.installed.note: An agent was installed into the editable set. The name is user data.

ui.notices.agents.proactive.role: success toast body after enabling proactive messaging
ui.notices.agents.proactive.note: The agent may now start conversations on its own. The name is user data.

ui.notices.agents.reactive.role: success toast body after disabling proactive messaging
ui.notices.agents.reactive.note: Proactive messaging is off for this agent. The name is user data.

ui.notices.agents.save_unconfirmed.role: error toast body for an ambiguous save
ui.notices.agents.save_unconfirmed.tone: Honest uncertainty with the check the reader can make.
ui.notices.agents.save_unconfirmed.note: A transport failure or timeout means the write may or may not have landed. Never state it failed; names the verification step.

ui.notices.agents.saved.role: success toast body with the saved agent's name
ui.notices.agents.saved.note: An edit to an agent definition was saved. The name is user data.

ui.notices.agents.system_prompt_updated.note: An agent's system prompt was saved.

ui.notices.aida.unreachable.tone: Plain diagnosis; no blame, no exception text.
ui.notices.aida.unreachable.note: Shown when an Aida control request fails without an authored backend detail. The fallback half of userFacingMessage; backend-authored detail wins when present.

ui.notices.chat.answer_changed.note: The user edited an answer and the change was applied.

ui.notices.chat.archive_failed.role: warning toast body for a refused archive
ui.notices.chat.archive_failed.tone: States the failed act; a retry control follows.
ui.notices.chat.archive_failed.note: Archive was refused. The title is conversation/user data; backend detail is appended separately when present.

ui.notices.chat.archive_offered_no_name.role: generic noun in an archive confirmation when the conversation has no title
ui.notices.chat.archive_offered_no_name.note: Stands in for a conversation title this client does not know. Not an error; keep it a plain noun.

ui.notices.chat.archive_offered_verb.role: fixed tail of the archive-undo toast body
ui.notices.chat.archive_offered_verb.tone: Past-tense verb closing the sentence begun by the conversation name.
ui.notices.chat.archive_offered_verb.length: One word plus full stop; must stay short so truncation never eats it.
ui.notices.chat.archive_offered_verb.note: Rendered as a non-truncating tail after the conversation name, which is allowed to ellipsise. Keep it a verb phrase, not a sentence.

ui.notices.chat.ask_answered.role: success toast receipt prefix when a fleet answer was delivered
ui.notices.chat.ask_answered.note: Used alone only when the conversation's name is unknown; the named variant is preferred.

ui.notices.chat.ask_answered_named.role: success toast receipt naming the conversation the answer reached
ui.notices.chat.ask_answered_named.tone: Short past-tense verb phrase plus place.
ui.notices.chat.ask_answered_named.note: The name is a conversation title, user data, and must not be translated.

ui.notices.chat.ask_changed.role: success toast receipt prefix when a fleet answer revision was delivered
ui.notices.chat.ask_changed.note: Used alone only when the conversation's name is unknown.

ui.notices.chat.ask_changed_named.role: success toast receipt naming the conversation the revision reached
ui.notices.chat.ask_changed_named.tone: Short past-tense verb phrase plus place.
ui.notices.chat.ask_changed_named.note: The name is a conversation title, user data, and must not be translated.

ui.notices.chat.ask_declined.role: success toast body for a declined fleet ask when the conversation name is unknown
ui.notices.chat.ask_declined.note: No conversation name available, so the sentence ends after the preposition. Pair with ask_declined_named.

ui.notices.chat.ask_declined_named.role: success toast body for a declined fleet ask
ui.notices.chat.ask_declined_named.tone: Short receipt naming where the answer went.
ui.notices.chat.ask_declined_named.note: The name is the target conversation title, user data, appended after the fixed verb phrase.

ui.notices.chat.ask_dismissed.role: success toast body for a dismissed fleet ask when the conversation name is unknown
ui.notices.chat.ask_dismissed.note: No conversation name available, so the sentence ends after the preposition. Pair with ask_dismissed_named.

ui.notices.chat.ask_dismissed_named.role: success toast body for a dismissed fleet ask
ui.notices.chat.ask_dismissed_named.tone: Short receipt naming where the answer went.
ui.notices.chat.ask_dismissed_named.note: The name is the target conversation title, user data, appended after the fixed verb phrase.

ui.notices.chat.drafts_offered_name.role: count and noun at the head of the drafts-discard toast
ui.notices.chat.drafts_offered_name.length: Two words or a number plus noun; the head may truncate.
ui.notices.chat.drafts_offered_name.note: Followed by the fixed verb drafts_offered_verb. Count is the number of discarded drafts.

ui.notices.chat.drafts_offered_verb.role: fixed tail of the drafts-discard toast body
ui.notices.chat.drafts_offered_verb.tone: Past-tense verb closing the sentence begun by the count.
ui.notices.chat.drafts_offered_verb.length: One word plus full stop; must stay short so truncation never eats it.
ui.notices.chat.drafts_offered_verb.note: Rendered as a non-truncating tail; the count head may ellipsise.

ui.notices.chat.goal_clear_failed.role: error toast prefix when clearing the session goal fails
ui.notices.chat.goal_clear_failed.tone: Plain failure naming the control's act.
ui.notices.chat.goal_clear_failed.length: Short phrase; leads the toast before the backend's reason.
ui.notices.chat.goal_clear_failed.note: The backend's own reason follows this prefix, separated by a colon by the caller; keep it a fragment that reads as the start of one sentence.

ui.notices.chat.goal_cleared.role: info toast body confirming a goal was cleared
ui.notices.chat.goal_cleared.tone: Factual confirmation followed by the goal's own leading words.
ui.notices.chat.goal_cleared.length: One line; the goal clip may ellipsise.
ui.notices.chat.goal_cleared.note: The goal text is user data, already clipped before interpolation. The separator is a middot with spaces.

ui.notices.chat.goal_dismiss_failed.role: error toast prefix when dismissing the goal fails
ui.notices.chat.goal_dismiss_failed.length: Short phrase; leads the toast before the backend's reason.
ui.notices.chat.goal_dismiss_failed.note: The backend's own reason follows this prefix.

ui.notices.chat.goal_done.role: info toast body confirming a goal was marked done
ui.notices.chat.goal_done.tone: Factual confirmation plus the recovery path.
ui.notices.chat.goal_done.length: One line at toast width; the goal clip may shorten.
ui.notices.chat.goal_done.note: Names where the goal went and the command that sets it again. Goal text is user data; /goal is a literal command and must not be translated.

ui.notices.chat.goal_done_failed.role: error toast prefix when marking the goal done fails
ui.notices.chat.goal_done_failed.length: Short phrase; leads the toast before the backend's reason.
ui.notices.chat.goal_done_failed.note: The backend's own reason follows this prefix.

ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_cleared.role: success toast body for a bulk read acknowledgement
ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_cleared.note: Count is the number of chats whose unread marks were cleared. Followed by zero or more remainder sentences.

ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_deferred.role: remainder sentence in a bulk read receipt
ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_deferred.tone: Neutral explanation of a deferral, not a failure.
ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_deferred.note: Some marks live on other devices and will clear when those devices update. Count is that number.

ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_none_clear.role: warning toast lead when no mark was cleared
ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_none_clear.note: Lead of a warning receipt; remainder sentences are appended after it.

ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_nothing.role: info toast body when the bulk action had nothing to do
ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_nothing.note: A request-level fact, not a claim that no unread marks exist on screen.

ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_superseded.role: remainder sentence in a bulk read receipt
ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_superseded.note: A newer result arrived before the acknowledgement, so those marks stay unread. Count is that number.

ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_unknown.role: remainder sentence in a bulk read receipt
ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_unknown.tone: Neutral explanation of a failed clear.
ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_unknown.note: Those marks could not be cleared and remain unread. Count is that number.

ui.notices.chat.seed_invalid.role: error toast body for an invalid seed field
ui.notices.chat.seed_invalid.note: The seed field accepts numbers only. Technical field name 'seed' stays as the backend names it.

ui.notices.chat.send_in_flight.role: info/error toast body while the previous message is still sending
ui.notices.chat.send_in_flight.tone: Plain statement of the held state.
ui.notices.chat.send_in_flight.note: Explains why a new message was not sent. It is not a refusal of the message's content.

ui.notices.chat.unarchive_failed.role: warning toast body for a refused unarchive
ui.notices.chat.unarchive_failed.tone: States the failed act; a retry control follows.
ui.notices.chat.unarchive_failed.note: Unarchive was refused. The title is conversation/user data; backend detail is appended separately when present.

ui.notices.chat.undo.note: Puts back the state the toast is about. Not a generic app-wide Undo menu item.

ui.notices.chat.unread_backend_silent.role: fallback clause inside an unread-clear failure toast
ui.notices.chat.unread_backend_silent.tone: Plain diagnosis of a non-answering backend.
ui.notices.chat.unread_backend_silent.length: One short sentence, followed by another clause.
ui.notices.chat.unread_backend_silent.note: Used only when the failure carries no authored sentence. Composed into unread_not_cleared.

ui.notices.chat.unread_not_cleared.role: warning toast body when clearing unread marks failed
ui.notices.chat.unread_not_cleared.tone: Both facts: why it failed and that nothing changed.
ui.notices.chat.unread_not_cleared.note: The reason clause is either an authored backend sentence or unread_backend_silent. The second clause is fixed and must stay.

ui.notices.credentials.removed.role: warning toast body after clearing a credential reference
ui.notices.credentials.removed.tone: Factual reference plus the offer to restore it.
ui.notices.credentials.removed.note: The index is the number the control the user pressed shows. 'Credential' is product vocabulary, not user data.

ui.notices.credentials.stored.role: success toast body after a credential was captured
ui.notices.credentials.stored.tone: Confirmation plus how it is used and its safety.
ui.notices.credentials.stored.note: The keys are environment variable names, machine identifiers, joined with commas. Never translate key names or 'bash'.

ui.notices.credentials.unconfirmed.role: warning toast body when a credential store did not confirm the write
ui.notices.credentials.unconfirmed.tone: Honest uncertainty plus the retry that works.
ui.notices.credentials.unconfirmed.note: Count is the number of keys; keys are machine identifiers. The literal command '/credential' must not be translated.

ui.notices.credentials.unstored.role: warning toast body when a credential store refused the write
ui.notices.credentials.unstored.tone: Refusal plus the retry that works.
ui.notices.credentials.unstored.note: Count is the number of keys; keys are machine identifiers. The literal command '/credential' must not be translated.

ui.notices.credentials.updated.role: success toast body after a credential value was saved
ui.notices.credentials.updated.note: The key is a machine identifier (environment variable name) and must not be translated.

ui.notices.files.already_exists.role: error toast body when file creation collides
ui.notices.files.already_exists.note: A file with that name already exists, so nothing was created.

ui.notices.files.copy_failed.role: error toast body when a clipboard write is refused
ui.notices.files.copy_failed.note: The content is still on screen; this arm carries no manual-copy instructions.

ui.notices.files.copy_path_failed.role: error toast body when copying a file path fails
ui.notices.files.copy_path_failed.note: Names the thing that could not be copied.

ui.notices.files.created.role: success toast body after creating a file
ui.notices.files.created.tone: Short past-tense confirmation with the file name.
ui.notices.files.created.note: The name includes the extension and is user data.

ui.notices.files.highlights_update_faile.role: lead sentence of an error toast when highlights could not be updated
ui.notices.files.highlights_update_faile.tone: Plain failure lead; backend diagnosis is appended.
ui.notices.files.highlights_update_faile.note: Only the lead is keyed; the shared backend-error diagnosis and remedy follow from the transport module.

ui.notices.files.image_copied.role: success toast body after copying an image
ui.notices.files.image_copied.note: The image bytes are on the clipboard.

ui.notices.files.image_copy_failed.role: error toast body when the image clipboard write fails
ui.notices.files.image_copy_failed.note: Lead sentence; the gone variant covers the attachment no longer existing.

ui.notices.files.image_copy_failed_gone.role: error toast body when the image is gone before it can be copied
ui.notices.files.image_copy_failed_gone.note: The attachment is no longer in the session, which is why the clipboard write could not happen.

ui.notices.files.open_failed.role: error toast body when opening a local file fails
ui.notices.files.open_failed.tone: Plain failure plus the likely causes.
ui.notices.files.open_failed.note: The name is a file name, user data. Covers both file-open and reveal-in-folder refusals.

ui.notices.files.save_failed.role: error toast lead when saving a file fails
ui.notices.files.save_failed.tone: Plain failure lead; error detail may follow.
ui.notices.files.save_failed.note: The failure detail is appended after a colon by the caller when present.

ui.notices.files.save_failed_gone.role: error toast body when the image is gone before it can be saved
ui.notices.files.save_failed_gone.note: The attachment is no longer in the session, which is why the save could not happen.

ui.notices.hub.agent_delisted.note: The agent's public listing was removed from the hub. The agent itself still exists locally.

ui.notices.hub.downloaded.role: success toast body after a hub download
ui.notices.hub.downloaded.tone: Short past-tense confirmation naming the installed agent.
ui.notices.hub.downloaded.note: The name is the installed agent name, user data.

ui.notices.hub.downloaded_collision.role: warning toast body when a downloaded agent duplicates an existing local name
ui.notices.hub.downloaded_collision.tone: States what happened and the consequence, then the repair.
ui.notices.hub.downloaded_collision.note: Both names are user data. Two agents answering one name is a real hazard; keep the consequence and the rename instruction.

ui.notices.hub.downloaded_renamed.role: success toast body when the hub renamed the agent on install
ui.notices.hub.downloaded_renamed.tone: States the outcome and why the name differs.
ui.notices.hub.downloaded_renamed.note: Both names are user data. The dash is an em dash with spaces.

ui.notices.hub.team_pulled.role: success toast body after pulling an organization team
ui.notices.hub.team_pulled.tone: Short past-tense confirmation naming the team.
ui.notices.hub.team_pulled.note: The name is the stored team name, user data.

ui.notices.hub.team_pulled_collision.role: success toast body when the pulled team duplicated a local name
ui.notices.hub.team_pulled_collision.tone: States the outcome and the existing name in parentheses.

ui.notices.hub.team_pulled_renamed.role: warning toast body when the published name was unusable
ui.notices.hub.team_pulled_renamed.tone: Explains the rename in two sentences.
ui.notices.hub.team_pulled_renamed.note: Both names are user data; the second sentence gives the reason the stored name differs.

ui.notices.links.open_failed.role: error toast body when a link cannot be opened
ui.notices.links.open_failed.note: Used for external links refused for reasons other than loopback/private addresses.

ui.notices.links.open_local_blocked.role: error toast body when a link points at the local machine or network
ui.notices.links.open_local_blocked.tone: Plain failure plus the app's deliberate policy.
ui.notices.links.open_local_blocked.note: The app refuses loopback and private-network URLs on purpose; do not soften it into a temporary error.

ui.notices.main.consent_body_many.role: macOS/Windows notification body for the browser consent queue
ui.notices.main.consent_body_many.length: Two short sentences; OS banner body, keep under ~170 characters.
ui.notices.main.consent_body_many.note: Count is the number of pending site approvals. Rendered outside the app window.

ui.notices.main.consent_body_one.role: macOS/Windows notification body for one browser consent request
ui.notices.main.consent_body_one.tone: Direct request naming the site and the action.
ui.notices.main.consent_body_one.length: Two short sentences; OS banner body, keep under ~170 characters.
ui.notices.main.consent_body_one.note: The origin is a URL origin, machine data, and must not be translated.

ui.notices.main.consent_title.role: macOS/Windows notification title for a browser consent request
ui.notices.main.consent_title.note: Tells the reader a website is asking to be opened by an agent. Not a security warning.

ui.notices.main.update_hold_body.role: macOS/Windows notification body while an app update installs
ui.notices.main.update_hold_body.tone: Plain explanation of the wait and the relaunch.
ui.notices.main.update_hold_body.length: Three sentences; OS banner body, keep under ~250 characters.
ui.notices.main.update_hold_body.note: Explains why the app will not open, what happens after, and that clicking does not shorten the wait. The relaunch clause is a separate keyed sentence.

ui.notices.main.update_hold_no_relaunch.role: relaunch clause inside the update-hold notification
ui.notices.main.update_hold_no_relaunch.tone: Honest instruction when no automatic relaunch exists.
ui.notices.main.update_hold_no_relaunch.length: One sentence; appended inside the notification body.
ui.notices.main.update_hold_no_relaunch.note: Used when the updater could not arrange to reopen the app; the reader must start it by hand.

ui.notices.main.update_hold_relaunch.role: relaunch clause inside the update-hold notification
ui.notices.main.update_hold_relaunch.tone: Reassuring statement of what happens next.
ui.notices.main.update_hold_relaunch.length: One sentence; appended inside the notification body.
ui.notices.main.update_hold_relaunch.note: Used when an automatic relaunch was arranged.

ui.notices.main.update_hold_title.role: macOS/Windows notification title while an app update installs
ui.notices.main.update_hold_title.note: Names the product, so do not translate 'Local Operator'.

ui.notices.sessions.clear_failed.role: error toast body when clearing a conversation fails
ui.notices.sessions.clear_failed.tone: Plain failure with the transport detail.
ui.notices.sessions.clear_failed.note: The detail is an error message, machine text, or the unknown_error fallback.

ui.notices.sessions.id_copied.role: success toast body after copying a session id
ui.notices.sessions.id_copied.note: Session ID is product vocabulary for the conversation identifier.

ui.notices.sessions.id_copy_failed.role: error toast body when copying a session id fails
ui.notices.sessions.id_copy_failed.note: The clipboard write was refused; no identifier is shown.

ui.notices.sessions.sign_out_failed.role: error toast body when signing out fails
ui.notices.sessions.sign_out_failed.tone: Plain failure with the transport detail.
ui.notices.sessions.sign_out_failed.note: The detail is an error message, machine text.

ui.notices.sessions.signed_out.role: success toast body after signing out

ui.notices.sessions.unknown_error.role: fallback detail inside a failure toast
ui.notices.sessions.unknown_error.tone: Neutral placeholder when no error message exists.
ui.notices.sessions.unknown_error.note: Never shown alone; fills the detail slot of clear_failed. Prefer a translated neutral noun phrase.

ui.notices.settings.system_prompt_update.note: The global system prompt was saved.

ui.notices.variables.create_failed.role: error toast body when a session variable cannot be created
ui.notices.variables.create_failed.note: Used only when the failure carries no authored sentence.

ui.notices.variables.delete_failed.role: error toast body when a session variable cannot be deleted
ui.notices.variables.delete_failed.note: Used only when the failure carries no authored sentence.

ui.notices.variables.update_failed.role: error toast body when a session variable cannot be updated
ui.notices.variables.update_failed.note: Used only when the failure carries no authored sentence.
